title: Four plausible trading ideas that failed after costs
limitations: This public package is a synthesis of frozen final metrics, not a release of private feature-level datasets.
The four experiments used different horizons and therefore should not be pooled into one effect estimate.
Slippage and spread assumptions differ from commission-only studies elsewhere in this repository.
reopeningConditions: A genuinely untouched period with positive net expectancy
A directional mechanism distinct from magnitude prediction
Historical data at a cadence matched to the trading horizon
